$description: Design tokens of SIGTA, in the W3C Design Tokens format. The single source of the look: theme.ts reads them and the catalog (/design/) shows them. A value in braces refers to another token.

brand.$description: Colors of the SIGTA logo. Only for the brand: the logo and its surroundings.

navy.$description: The building and the word SIGTA.

cyan.$description: The base bar of the isotype.

fiuba.$description: Primary scale of the interface. Index 5 (#009fe2) is the light blue of the FIUBA logo; on white it does not reach text contrast, so buttons and links use index 7 and hovers index 8.

text.$description: Text, the near black of the logo (Mantine black).

primaryColor.$description: Name of the scale used by buttons, links and focus.

dimmedShade.$description: Gray shade of dimmed text. Mantine uses 6, which reads at 3.3:1 on white; 7 reaches 8.2:1.

sans.$description: Text and headings of the interface: the system font, until the institutional one is defined.

brand.$description: Only in the logo, already drawn as outlines in the SVG files: the interface does not load it.

size.$description: Text sizes, the fz and size props (xs to xl). md is the body text.

heading.$description: Title order={1} to order={6}. Title variant="display" (the landing headline) grows with the screen in typography.module.css.

spacing.$description: Margins, paddings and gaps (m, p, gap, spacing props).

default.$description: Radius of every component that does not say otherwise: buttons, inputs, panels.

breakpoint.$description: Screen widths. Below sm (48em) controls are at least 44px tall.

component.$description: Decisions for a single component. Each one refers to a general token, so changing it here changes that component everywhere.

radius.$description: The white boxes of the side menu.

minHeight.$description: Minimum height of a control on a phone (below breakpoint.sm).
